items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: We went to Africa with him. A creative opportunity. We did a four week tour to Africa. It was wonderful. I sang African songs in the African language with him.

ctx.x: You got to perform with him. Didn’t you get to perform with him?
Oh yeah. We went to Africa with him. A creative opportunity. We did a four week tour to Africa. It was wonderful. I sang African songs in the African language with him.
